availability.statement: Access depends on current Tiingo account entitlements; a 403 means this credential is not entitled to the requested capability.

common_pitfalls: Tickers must be lowercase (eurusd, not EURUSD).
Forex market is 24/5 -- weekends have no data.
resample_freq '1day' is distinct from EOD stock resampling.
description: Foreign exchange currency pairs with real-time quotes and historical prices.
ticker_format: Lowercase concatenated pair, e.g. eurusd, gbpusd, usdjpy
workflows: Use get_forex_quote for the current top-of-book bid/ask for a pair.
Use get_forex_prices for historical OHLCV data; supports 1min to 1day resampling.
